lines.text: SCENE 1 (The museum. Silence. Darkness)

A young woman stands near a stretch of velvet rope. She has a can in one hand and stares up at an enormous human sculpture. After a moment, a young man in uniform steps across the barrier and approaches her.
...you stepped over the line. Miss.
I know.
Umm, you stepped over…
It's "Ms".
Okay, sorry, Ms, but, ahh...
I meant to.
What?
Step over…
Yeah, I figured you did. I mean, the way you did it and all, kinda deliberate like.
I know.
You're not supposed to do that.
That's why I tried it....
Why?
...to see what would happen.
Oh. Well...me, I s'pose.
"Me?"
No, I mean, I'm what happens, I guess. I have to walk over, like I've done, and ask you to take a step back. Could you, please?
And if someone doesn't?
Step back?
What then?
...you're not gonna step back?
No...I mean, yes, I probably will, but just for interest's sake, what would you do if?
I'm...geez, I'm not sure. I've never had anyone not step back. I've only said it, like, four times. And every time they've done it. Stepped back.
What if I'm your first? Non-stepper, I mean. Then what?
Hell, I dunno...I'm off in, like, ten minutes, I'd probably just stand here, make sure you didn't touch anything.
Really?
Pretty much, yeah. I'd let next shift talk to you, kick you out or whatever.
You wouldn't grab me or anything?

Nah. That's too...you know. That's a total hassle, you end up rolling around on the ground, you'd probably sue the place, or me, and then...I'd get fired for doing my job. Screw that... (Beat) Could you do that for me, though?
Which, roll around on the ground or sue you?
No, step back behind the line there… I'd appreciate it.
Not really.
No, seriously, I would. I'd definitely appreciate it....
I mean, "not really" I'm not going to....
I thought you just said you probably will....
Yeah, "probably." I decided not to.
Hey, you're not gonna mess up my weekend with this, are you?
I wasn't planning on it, but...I'm not completely against it, either.
See, if you get all crazy, then I gotta write up a report and stuff, I'm here till six, six-thirty easy, and I have a second job to get to.
Tonight? Friday night?
Yep. Right after this, at the video store...
Why would anyone work two jobs on Friday night?
...for money.
Of course...sorry. (Looks at him again) Oh...oh, right! That's where I...I've seen you in there. You helped me once, I think.
Yeah?
Uh-huh.
With what?
The Picture of Dorian Gray...you found it in Drama, not Classics.
Right, I remember that.
Somebody'd misplaced it....
Yes...behind Cabaret. The "Joel Grey" fiasco...
Yeah, you said you found it with Dirty Dancing once, too, or something....
I did, you're right...that's funny.
Anyway, you helped me, that was nice....
Thanks. But, you're not gonna return the favor, right?
You mean the...? (She points back toward the velvet rope.)
Yeah.
No, sorry, I can't.
Why is that? (Pointing) It's a pretty good-sized sculpture. You can see it just fine from there....
Truthfully? I'm building up my nerve, and if I go back over, I'll probably be a big wuss about it and take off....
About what? The "wuss" part, I mean....
I was going to deface the statue.
Oh. Oh... (Pointing) Is that paint?
Yes.
Great…
They share a smile.
Paint's not really the best thing to have in a museum. Why do you have that?
I was going to do something to the nude. Mess it up or...
What, you mean, like, colour it or something?
I was thinking more of painting a big dick on it, but whatever....
Well, you could still colour it in...the dick.
EVELYN smiles at this.
True. It might look kinda weird....
Oh, I think a graffiti penis is gonna be plenty odd already.... (Beat) So, right over the leaves there, or just a free-floating number?
Probably anatomically correct. I mean, if you're gonna do it, why not....
...do it right? Absolutely. And, would "why" be completely out of the question here?
Why the "dick"?
Uh-huh. I mean, since I basically have to jump you now if you lift that can up, it'd help with my report....
Because I don't like art that isn't true.
"True." What do you mean?
False art. I hate that.....
No, I understand the words you've used here, although they're both pretty subjective: "art." "Truth."
Exactly! That's the beauty of art...it's subjective.
Right, but see, I don't know what you're referring to then. I mean, specifically.... (Beat) Didn't Oscar Wilde say something like, "In art there is no such thing as a universal truth..." Or whatever?

Yes...very good. "A truth in art is that whose contradictory is also true." Right, but that's an aesthetic. I'm talking about practicalities. Censorship. (She points.) This sculpture. It's fake, it's not real. Therefore, false art...
No, it's a Fornecelli, it definitely is. I read the little thingie there one time....
Yes, but the leaf cluster isn't.
It's not?
No.
What is it, a pastie or something, like strippers have?
It's plaster...it was added by a committee who had complaints from local townspeople.
Really?
Uh-huh.
I didn't know that…
They made a petition and got that put on, thereby removing its subjectivity as art.
When did they do this?
Seven or eight years ago now, I think. Before I got here, anyway.
Huh.
See, they objected to his "thing." The shape of it. Said it was too life-like. (Beat) It's supposed to be "god," you know...that's what pisses 'em off.
Huh.
No, and I don't know why...we're always calling him "the creator." (Beat) Look at it, you can see the...see right behind the grapes there, you can just see his....
Yeah...he's not really supposed to have one of those, is he?
...grapes. Yes. You're absolutely, huh. Didn't even cover him properly. Shoddy craftmanship!
I mean, if you're gonna do it, at least....
...exactly. Do it right. (Beat) But why deface the thing? I mean, just out of curiosity. Why not, say, knock the plaster off and expose his...you know...cluster… if you're trying to....
Because. That's so...expected.
Ahh...so, you're a student, then, or is this just basic anarchy?
Yep. Student.
Me too.
Yeah? What's your emphasis?
Ummm...taking out school loans, primarily, but I do sit in on a few English classes. You're in art?
Mmmm-hmmm. M F A.
Oh.
Applied theory and crit...
So, is this, like, a project?
No, I'm just getting started on my thesis project now. A big sorta installation..."thingie."
That's a good word, huh? "Thingie."
It is.... (Points) Anyway, this is only a pet peeve....
Thesis? You're graduating....
In May.
'Kay. I'm only a Junior....
Huh. You seem older.
Well, I am. I mean, older than twenty, anyhow...I worked for a couple years. Made money.
Not enough, though. Still got two jobs...
Don't forget the school loans...
Right. So, basically, you're...fucked.
Yep. But at least I'm educated, so I comprehend that I'm fucked....
They stand there for a moment. ADAM checks his watch; EVELYN shakes her spray can.
You're cute. I don't like the way you wear your hair....
Thank you. I think....
No, you're definitely cute, but you shouldn't style it so much. Your hair. Just let it go...
'kay. I'll try that....
Your relief's late.
Yeah. Typical...
So, do you have to stay at your station until they spell you, or...?
No, at punch-out time, I'm supposed to get down there and do it. They can really be pricks about that....
You should go then....
Right. Yeah, I...can I call you?
What do you wanna call me?
Up. Just up, right now. Talk, maybe get crazy, take you to dinner...
Okay. Ahh...sure. (Beat) Do they allow you to do that here?
What, eat dinner?
I meant hit on the patrons....
...ummm, no, they've got a pretty strict policy about that, too, actually. But...
...ahh, the great equalizer. "But."
Exactly. I'll take the risk....
...good answer, grasshopper.
Huh?
"Kung Fu." On TV. Remember when he was a kid? The old guy with the fakey contact lenses, and the....
Oh, right...sure. "Grasshopper." I don't really watch much television....
My brothers loved that show. (Beat) So, do you want a number?
Absolutely! (Checks) Damn, I don't have a pen.
Me either. (Thinks) Here...gimme the jacket.
What?
Your jacket. Take it off for a second.
Oh, that's, umm...it's supposed to be a "blazer."
What?
It's my own...'s not part of the uniform. It's mine.
Good. Then you'll always have it on you...from the looks of it.
ADAM follows her orders. EVELYN lays the coat open on the floor, looks around, then uncaps the paint and sprays a phone number inside.
...don't worry, it dries quick.
Thanks. Okay, so, I'll...yeah. (He glances back.) Good luck with the...nice to meet you. Again.
You too.
ADAM smiles at her, looks back again, walks off. EVELYN is left alone. She turns back to the statue and starts shaking her paint can. The little ball bearings inside rattle loudly.
SCENE 2 - (The auditorium patio/Adam's apartment)
ADAM standing with EVELYN. He looks a bit different, not as bulky and he's letting his hair go. Same jacket under his arm.
...no, seriously. You have.
Yeah?
No question.
I dunno. I think I still look....
You can definitely tell. You can.
Really?
Definitely. Plus, the hair.../I bet your friends say something. Twenty bucks...
Well, I'm glad..../I mean, I can't tell and so I figured...twenty bucks?
Yes. That's because you see "you" every day. Shower, getting dressed, that kind of thing. But...
So do you.
I don't see you shower. Or getting dressed...
No, I meant every day. So far, anyway, since we first went to....
I know, I'm kidding.
Oh. Okay... (Beat) I'd like that, though. If you would....
Which?
Both if you want. Either. Anything, any moment I can get with you...that's what I'd like.
Ask and you shall receive....
So, I'm asking, then.
So you shall be receiving then....
They share a brief kiss; he looks around self-consciously.
P D A. Public display of affection. I'm not used to that....
No? I don't mind....
Really?
Nah, whose business is it? Ours, right? Kiss if we want to, make love in a bathroom stall...who cares?
I'd start with the administration....
Yeah, but why should they? I mean...we're two adults, we....
I think this is a bigger discussion than before Jenny and Phillip get here..../I mean, no, I'd love to have it with you, the discussion, and I agree, somewhat, but....
Whatever./I understand....
Another time, we'll definitely discuss it.
Another time...I'd rather do it.
Lemme go check the men's room... (He laughs.) ...you amaze me.
I'm glad. (Beat) And you amaze me, you do. Look at you!
...it's just a little jogging.
No, it's not. It's not just that...you're running, you're eating better, are you still lifting?
Yeah...I mean, I didn't today, but....
That's okay.
No, I'm gonna...so, yeah, alright, it's a whole routine thing. You're right....
Do you like doing it?
Honestly...no. I totally hate it!
They laugh.
So why would you...?
Because you suggested it. Which is kinda pathetic, but true....
You shouldn't do something you don't wanna do.
Yeah, you should, why not? If it's for someone...I mean, I'm doing it for you.
It's a life change. Really...
Right.
I gave you a couple ideas and you're changing your entire life. I'm very proud of you.
Thank you... (Cockney) ...'enry 'iggins.
What's that?/Who's....
Nothing./'S from a book. Play, actually.
Oh. Not the one we're seeing, though, is it?
No, no, a musical...this is, umm, Medea.
Oh yeah, right. (Smiles) I read this as an undergrad, I like it....
Ahh, you like Medea, huh? Should I be nervous?
No, not too much...I mean, unless we have kids.
(Laughing) ...alright...
So...are you still keeping your journal? It really does help....
Yes.
Will you let me read it?
...some time.
Good.
They stand for a moment. EVELYN checks her watch.
And what about you?
What about me?
That's what I mean...I don't know.
What?
Nothing. I don't really know anything about you....
Yes, you do!
I don't. Not really...
What's my name?
Evelyn.
Where am I from?
Illinois. Near Chicago?
Yes. How old am I?
Ummm...twenty-five, maybe.
That's exactly right. Almost twenty-six. Sign?
Gemini, I think....
The twins, yes.
Does that mean you have a split personality?
No, it means I was born in June.
Oh. (Beat) And you're, what, a sculptress, right? An artist...
Yep. Anything else you wanna know?
Yes...everything!
So ask then...
Well...why are you always asking me questions if it's no big deal.
Because you make me curious...I'm a curious person.
I'm curious, too, though!
Like I said...so ask then.
...why do you like me?
What?
Me...why would you like me? I'm not anything, I mean...and you're so....
Don't do that, okay? That's the only thing about you I don't like...what you see in yourself. Or don't see. Your insecurities. (Beat) Do you like me?
Of course, you know I do....
Do I appear to like you? Hmm?
Yes...it seems like it, yeah.
I do like you. Do you think I'm smart?
I think you're amazing...and you have a great ass. Just thought you should know....
Not part of my query, but thank you.
Welcome...
And do I seem to know my own mind? I mean, generally....
No question.
So, don't you trust me, then, to know how I feel?
Yeah. No, you're right....
Don't worry about why when what is right in front of you.
Those're very wise words from someone with such a great ass....
(Playfully) Kiss me, grasshopper…
They start to kiss again as a young couple approaches.
Ah, ah, ah...P D A.
I don't think anybody wants to watch you kiss, Adam...we'll be eating later.
Hey, Phillip, hello! Evelyn, this is Phillip, and his fiancée, Jenny....
"Hellos" all around.
So, we should grab our tickets, and.... (Stopping to look) Adam, what's up with you? D'you lost weight?
...a little, maybe.
No, he cut his hair...or something. That's it, right?
Umm, yeah. I mean, both, sort of.
Huh. Okay, so, let's...come on.
JENNY and PHILLIP lead the way. EVELYN stares at ADAM as they follow; he pulls a twenty out of his pocket and places it in her hand.
SCENE 3 - (The living room)
ADAM and EVELYN sitting on a couch. JENNY and PHILLIP in opposing chairs. Everyone holds a drink.
...so, tell me this again, you're going to what?
Underwater. We're going to get married underwater....
You've gotta be kidding me!
...like those Life magazine photos you see or whatever./Seriously.
Huh./Is that, like, a "California" thing?
No. We wanted to try something bold....
That oughta do it.
This is crazy, really. And, so, if we want to attend we have to....
...get in the tank with us. You bet.
No, honey, I thought we said....
...we haven't, okay, no, we haven't settled that part completely, but....
My dad could never do that. I mean, my mom would try, she would, but dad....
Maybe people can watch from the glass window things or whatever, but I'd prefer if they came in with us....
He drains his glass, looking at ADAM
That is nuts....
Well, I applaud you. I think it's very....
(To EVELYN) Yeah, well, don't expect my buddy here to follow in our footsteps. He's the least adventurous person I know....
Really?
Absolutely! And the marriage thing? Uh-uh, not gonna happen, sorry. I don't know how many nights I listened to this guy say, "not me, man, I'm never getting hooked, no way, man..."
Is that right? Well, well...
Listen, don't encourage him. My room-mate doesn't need any....
...former room-mate...
...more encouragement. (Beat) I'm gonna look stupid in one of those wet suits.
Hey, let's not be a party-pooper here, my friend... (Indicating JENNY) ...this could've been yours.
ADAM laughs thinly; EVELYN doesn't understand.
I know, I know....
Right?
I'm lost. What's...?
I stole Jenny away from Adam....
Come on...
I did! (To JENNY) Didn't I?
No, you didn't, stop being.... (To EVELYN) Adam and I had a class together, but he never got up the nerve to ask me out.
Is that true?
Something like that...

Four months we sat next to each other— I'm borrowing his pen, like, all the time, hint-hint— and he's this total monk the whole semester...anyway, Phil picks him up from class one day, sees me, and we went to mini-golf that same night.
I cannot tell a lie...I've got the moves, God help me.
God help all of us....
A collective laugh
Well, like I said, I think it's great. It's really amazing, it is, to find anybody willing to take a risk today. To look a little silly or different or anything. Bravo! (Toasts) To people with balls…
They all toast, even PHILLIP with his empty glass, but he looks over at ADAM. ADAM blushes.
"Balls," huh? Yep, that's my Jenny....
JENNY slaps him on the shoulder and blushes again.
You know what I mean. Guts. That kinda thing...
Right. I got it.
(Toasting) "To balls, long may they wave..."
They all smile and "mock" drink again.

I'll tell you what took some balls, the museum thing, a few weeks back, with the...balls. You guys read about that?! I mean, Adam, of course you did, you were supposed to be guarding it, but—Evelyn, you hear about it?
(Whispering) The penis...
(Whispering) Yes, I did. Why are we whispering?
Because you don't say "penis" in Jenny's house. But we're at my place now, and so we sing it from the eaves! "Penis!! Pe-nis!!!"
Okay, bar's closing, last call....
No, seriously, do you believe that shit? Somebody with the gall to do that kinda bullshit on our campus?! That fucking burns me up....
I'm an artist, so I didn't....
We should probably get, ummm....
I mean, this isn't Berkeley! (Beat) What does that mean, anyway? "I'm an artist?"
It means nothing, really, just that I understand the impulse....
You what?!
Evelyn, maybe we should....
No, wait Adam, I wanna hear… what "impulse?" It's called "vandalism."
Does anyone want dessert?
PHILLIP holds up a hand to hush the group. He turns back to EVELYN.
No, hold on, this is rich. Go ahead...
Just that...I don't think it was just kids playing. I think it was a sort of statement, a kind of....
...a statement?
Yeah, I do....
What kind of statement would that be? It was pornography....
No, it wasn't.
Yes, it was....
Pornography is meant to titillate, to excite you. Did you see a picture of what happened?
We did, yeah....
Does a penis excite you? I mean, just any ol' penis?
You're funny. And that's not the point.
It's totally the point...how about you, Jenny, did you like what you saw? Did it get you hot?
This is, like, uncalled for, okay? All she said was....

I know what she said, why don't you let her speak? (To JENNY) Did you wanna see anything else? Huh? Okay, then...all I'm saying is that, in my opinion, it wasn't pornography, it was a statement. Of course, that's the beauty of statements, like art, they're subjective. You and I can think completely different things and we can both be right...unless, and this seems quite probable, you just can't stand to lose an argument.
Quiet for a moment from the group.
Wow. The postgraduate mind at work...
I'll help you get dessert, Jenny, if you want to....
...I still don't think that makes it a statement. It's graffiti....
What do you mean, it would be a huge statement...especially for a town like this.
Hey, some of us are from "a town like this," so maybe you should watch it.
Well, we've all gotta be from somewhere....
What do you mean by that?
I mean, it's a little college town in the middle of nowhere and....
One you chose, presumably....
No, it chose me, actually. Full scholarship. So, as I was saying....
You've got a real winning way, you know that?
Look, Phil, it's no big deal, let's just....
Which "take back the night" rally did you find her at, Adam?
...can I finish, please?! Jesus, you're really the obnoxious type, you know that? (To ADAM) How long did you have to stomach this guy?
Everyone except EVELYN sort of freezes on that one.
Evelyn.
Anyhow, who knows what the person was saying by it, we don't, but I think it was a gesture. A kind of manifesto, if you will....
(Dryly) I don't think a person's dick can be a manifesto. Uh-uh. You can write a manifesto on your thing, but your thing can't be one...I'm sure I read that somewhere.
See? You're just trying to be....
I'm not trying to be anything! Who the hell do you think you are, a few double dates and telling me anything about who I am? Un-fucking-believable!
This is getting a little, ahh....
...Adam, you can really pick 'em. Wow, man!
Look, it's not, let's just forget the....
You're not gonna take his side in this, are you?
I'm not taking sides, I'm trying to get outta here with just a touch of dignity, okay? Jesus...
I've got a test tomorrow, anyway....
"Statement," she says!
Shut the fuck up, alright? Just fuck right off...how would you know? I think she was making one, so that's my opinion....
Jenny, thanks for everything. Phillip, I'll call ya, or whatever, but we're gonna....
Yeah? How do you know it was a girl?
...I don't. I didn't say it was a woman.
Girl, woman, whatever. You said "she," how do you know that?
I don't, I just said. It's a guess. What it was, where it was placed. An educated guess...
You are not...she's not trying to take a poke at my being an undergrad, is she? Adam, tell me she didn't just....
Can we stop, now, please?! You guys...
Evelyn, let's go...
Hey, artiste...how'd you know it was a woman who painted the cock, huh? Very, very suspicious there...
You are such a prick, man, how do you go on, day after day? (To ADAM) Let's go...
She rises, snatches up her things and moves towards the door
Adam? Are you coming?
I'm...yeah, but, just go. I'll meet you downstairs, I just wanna...go ahead.
'kay. (To JENNY) You're very sweet. Good luck...
She heads for the door and exits.
"Good luck." Hey, fuck you! (To ADAM) Where in hell did you meet that bitch?!/What'd she do, give you a haircut and a blow job and now you're her puppy?!/You don't have to go....
...at the museum./No, I'm not her.... (To JENNY) The wedding sounds great. Really...it sounds...yeah.
He wanders off. PHILLIP and JENNY sit in silence.
...what?
SCENE 4 - (The bedroom)
An explosion of color and patterns. An enormous bed in the middle of it all. Groovy lighting.
ADAM and EVELYN in bed. Holding each other, staring off. A video camera on a tripod nearby
Nice.
Very. Yes.
Our bodies are beginning to understand one another....
You're right, I mean....
Getting a rhythm. And less inhibited.
Yep.
He leans over and whispers something in her ear. A huge smile across her face. She turns and whispers back to him. They laugh and kiss for a moment. They hold one another.
(Quietly) Were you always like this before? So...you know....
...shy? Just about the fact that no one would sleep with me. That's all.
Come on...
Seriously. You're only, like, I dunno, the third person I've ever....

Yes, I mean it. And they were both young. I mean, I was too, I wasn't, like, hanging out at a day care or anything, but...it was during high school mostly. So...you're sort of in uncharted waters here.
I don't wanna blow your cover but… I could kinda tell.
(Smiling) Yeah? Well, that's okay....
And nobody here at school?
Nothing serious. Dates. Some close calls. But not anyone...you know.
...like Jenny.
No.
You sorry you didn't ask her out? I mean, if I wasn't in the equation....
Not really. We just never got the right… whatever. I sorta blew that one. Anyway, it's kind of weird talking about....
It's okay. That's nice to see, every so often. Someone gallant...

Which is medieval for "loser"... (Beat) I wanna tell you something—and this is not because we've been sleeping together or because you mentioned another girl, it's not—I can't stop thinking about you. I can't. I mean, it's not like a stalker situation...yet...but I'm finding myself hanging out by your classes. Following you...
I've noticed....

I figured, yeah. And taking my jacket off, like, thirty times a day and looking at your number. Staring at it. Wondering if you're looking at my number. And writing your name on anything! All over my books. In my food. Seriously, tracing your name in whatever I'm eating. I'm so whipped... you are dangerously close to owning me.
Wow...
I just signed my relationship death warrant, didn't I?/What a dork...
...no, it's sweet!/It is!! (She kisses him.) Were you nervous earlier? I mean, about us with the video?
Nah. Not really. (Beat) A bit...
Sure?
Yeah. It's just...let's not watch it, okay? Do we have to do that?
Not if you don't want to....
Good. I don't think I could get into that, actually....
Why not? It'd be fun....
I don't really need to see myself doing that. Doing...stuff.
See, I'm totally different. I think everyone should see themselves doing it, and their friends should see it, too.
And that's why the tape's gonna stay at my place....
She smiles at this, kissing him.
Don't be so frightened of everything.
I'm not. Not frightened, anyway. I just don't think that's a thing other people need to see. Ever. My ass...
People like who...Phillip?
No, that's fine, you can show it to him.... (Beat) Are you nuts?!
Why is he your friend?
Do you really wanna go over that...?
I just don't get it.
What's to get? We were room-mates, we occasionally see each other, have a drink....
I just don't think you need that kind of person in your life. No one does.
(Mock-serious) ...it may be a touch early to start dictating who my friends are.
(With charm) Yeah...I s'pose.
Geez, he really got under your skin, didn't he?
Under. Over. Around. I hate that kind of guy....
What kind?
That kind. Whatever he is, that's what I hate....
I'll let him know.
No, God, no, don't give him the satisfaction. And he'd take it, too, believe me....
Nah, maybe it'd help him, you know, be better...or something.
The only thing that would help him is a fucking knife through his throat....
They grow quiet for a moment. ADAM studies EVELYN.
Okay, I'm glad I don't have a pet rabbit or anything right now....
(Laughing) You know what I mean.
Ummmm, no, not really.
I've just been around his type, that's all. And I don't like 'em.
Yeah, I got that part....
No big deal.
Right, no, it was the "knife through the throat" part that was the big deal, I thought....
Oh, that's just an expression.
...from where, Transylvania?
She kisses him.
No...from the "Scorned Girl's Handbook."
Ahhh. Right...page 666.
(Smiling) You've been peeking. You know what happens to peekers, don't you? I'll show you...but you have to do me a favor.
What's that?
She starts to slip under the covers.
...just smile. Smile into the camera. For as long as you can…
SCENE 7 - (The lawn)
PHILLIP and ADAM sitting on their jackets between classes, talking. PHILLIP has a pair of sunglasses perched on his head. ADAM has a bandage across his nose.
...I'm serious, it looks good.
Phil, I look like a hockey player....
Yeah, but a distinguished one.
They chuckle.
What'd you do, anyway?
...I fell.
Come on...
Seriously, I did....
You sound like a battered wife. "I fell...."
That's not funny.
